5569 George Gordon Noel Byron

 
 
 
NUMBER:
5569
 
AUTHOR:
George Gordon Noel Byron, Lord Byron
 (1788–1824)
 
QUOTATION:
I only know we loved in vain;
  I only feel—farewell! farewell!
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Farewell! if ever fondest Prayer.
